_comment: Survey config. Screens are rendered in order. tier core means always asked; tier optional may be skipped when the answer is already known. cn_tag is applied on completion with {value} substituted.
title: Two minutes, all taps

intro.heading: Tell us what matters to you.
intro.lede: Fourteen questions, almost all of them taps. It takes about two minutes and it decides what the campaign does next.

screens.question: What brings you to this campaign?

options.label: The money could be better spent

screens.question: What is your connection to the Memorial?

options.label: A relative's name is on it

screens.heading: That is the part that decides everything else.
screens.body: The next few questions are about what you want the campaign to do with it.

screens.question: Which of these worry you? Pick as many as apply.

options.label: Politics inside a place of mourning

screens.question: If the campaign could win only one thing, which should it be?

options.label: Protect it as a place of mourning

screens.question: How urgent does this feel to you?
How well informed do you feel about what is actually planned?
How did you first hear about this?
What are you willing to do?

options.label: Share it with people I know

screens.heading: Almost done.
screens.body: Two quick ones so we know where you are and how to reach you.

screens.question: What is your postcode?
screens.note: It tells us which electorates the campaign is strongest in.

screens.question: Can we text you when something urgent happens?
screens.note: Rarely, and never more than matters. Reply STOP any time.

screens.question: Have you ever contacted your MP about anything?
Would you talk to someone from the campaign on the phone?

framing.family: You said someone in your family served. That is exactly who the Memorial was built for, and exactly who this is being taken from.
framing.served: You served. Nobody has more standing to say what that building is for.
framing.history: You said our history is being rewritten. Stopping that takes people who will not let it happen quietly.
framing.waste: You said the money could be better spent. Making that argument publicly costs money too, and it is far less than they are spending.
framing.secrecy: You said it was decided in secret. Secrecy only survives while nobody is looking.
framing.default: The campaign runs on people who do the next thing rather than the easy thing.

majorDonor.label: I can give more than that
majorDonor.subject: Supporting Defend Sacred Ground
